topic: Agent behind corporate proxy can't reach Datadog
environment: Forward proxy (Squid) required for all egress
symptom_pattern: After moving the Agent from a VM to a container, it reports no data at all. Logs show connection refused when sending transactions; the proxy team says they see no requests.
root_cause: datadog.yaml proxy settings still point at http://localhost:3128, which on the VM was the local proxy but inside the container is the Agent itself.
resolution_path: Point the proxy at the proxy container/host name and confirm with agent status
info_needed: where the proxy runs relative to the Agent

qa_pairs.tse_question: Where does the proxy run relative to the Agent container?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: It's another container called squid in the same compose project.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you share the proxy section of datadog.yaml?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: proxy: http: http://localhost:3128, https: http://localhost:3128, same as on the VM.
